newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody"s says may raise Rohm long-term debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody"s says may raise Rohm long-term debt rating.

text.p: Moody"s Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had placed Rohm Co Ltd"s Baa1 long-term debt rating under review for possible upgrading.
The rating agency said in a statement that its review would improve debt-protection measures through the introduction of new products and better cost controls.
Moody"s said it would also examine the growth potential of Rohm"s key markets as well as the company"s potential for improving its market share for certain core electronic components.
Rohm is one of Japan"s leading electronic component manufacturers.
